title: Paris
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text.
sideBSummary: Paris, blue, 48°51'24"N 2°21'8"E. Inland Europe map with a bullseye in the center. Compass with no anchor. No search box. The name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. P4-04b.

rules: Second blue Player card for Paris. Not a port. No search.
The bullseye in the map art is the city-card improvement slot. A card holds at most one improvement.
notes: Same coordinates as the search card: 48°51'24"N 2°21'8"E.
The recon report puts both Paris Player cards in the Player discard pile.
